structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a pump.fun coin called "Extropians". Its description is "Created on rapidlaunch.io @perrymetzger", which ties it to Perry Metzger, who started the 1990s Extropians mailing list. I could not find the post or event that triggered it. Several same-name coins launched in the same window. One of them, 7tgAf… (a non-pump address created about 7 minutes after this one), is already at about $346k market cap with $347k of volume in the last hour. That makes it the clear leader. This coin rose about 460% to around $22-24k, and GeckoTerminal already shows -5.9% over the last 5 minutes. It is also well below its all-time-high price.

narrative.description: Perry Metzger / Extropians: the techno-optimist transhumanist list that is often linked to Bitcoin's roots. It is probably reacting to a post by or about Metzger, but I could not confirm that.
narrative.why_spreading: The story has crypto-history appeal (Extropians, Hal Finney, the roots of Bitcoin). I found no specific trigger post, but a same-name coin reaching $346k suggests something real is moving it.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its only link is the rapidlaunch description naming @perrymetzger. Its X link points to a status on a recycled account (prottlegang11, with 6+ earlier usernames).
token_connection.competing_tokens: 7tgAfwawjdpqguKNc2wUNFgHQG5yG7Z5y1NQSpQoKT3h is at $346k market cap, $54k liquidity and $347k of volume in the last hour, so it is clearly the market's pick. At least 7 other same-name coins are dead.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 187 bundler wallets among roughly 312 holders, with the top bundler trader holding 29%. The dev-team hold rate is 10%. The creator has launched 3,949 tokens and is a serial deployer. The project's X account has been recycled at least 6 times. It was launched through the rapidlaunch tool.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so organic buyers can't be told apart from the bundle. The unique-buyer count (674) is fairly high.

structural_risks: The coin is a secondary copy of a same-name coin that is already far ahead
187 bundler wallets could dump into the bonding curve
Momentum is already fading on the 5-minute window

structured_output.counterargument: Its low $22k market cap gives lots of upside if the Extropians story keeps growing. Spillover from the leading coin sometimes pulls cheaper copies up by 2x. This coin was also created about 7 minutes before the leader, so some buyers may treat it as the "OG".

source_coverage.notes: Short on time. I searched the contract address and $Extropians and found nothing. Background on Metzger and the Extropians was found. DexScreener returned 403 when I tried to check the competing coin. I did not get to Reddit, Telegram, Discord or the project's GitHub link.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copy of a live story that has lost the race. It is heavily bundled, comes from a serial deployer, and the same-name coin people are actually buying is already at $346k. Its odds of doubling before falling 50% are below the pool's typical coin.
